title: Nourishing Crispy Italian Chicken Pilaf
description: A herbal and crispy Italian dish featuring jasmine rice and salt-baked chicken, perfect for a sick day, with a low-fat friendly twist from the Puglian region.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, salt, thyme, and rosemary.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned on all sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
In the same skillet, add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the jasmine rice to the skillet, cover, and reduce heat to low.
Simmer the rice for 15 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the parmesan cheese and parsley.
Serve the crispy chicken on top of the rice pilaf and drizzle with lemon juice.
